personality_one_liner: An uncompromised finance-grade offline ledger designed with iOS precision, calm neutral styling, and immutable audit trails.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing rhythm with compact horizontal pads, touch targets >= 44x44pt.

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom tab bar over scrolling lists
Apply translucent tinted base >= 80% opacity for foreground contrast
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or body text
Do not stack multiple heavy blur layers

screens.name: AppUnlock
screens.purpose: Biometric session check and secure local authorization gate.

states.empty: No secure session found. Please authenticate.
states.error: Biometric unlock failed. Tap to retry securely.

screens.layout: Centered immersive card with dark frosted backdrop, fingerprint/face id glyph, and fallback PIN option.

screens.name: WorkspaceChooser
screens.purpose: Select or create isolated workspace context (Personal, Family, Small Business).

states.empty: No workspaces found. Create your first workspace below.
states.error: Failed to load workspaces. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Vertical list of workspace selector cards with active workspace highlighted, plus sticky bottom 'Create Workspace' action.

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Primary cash flow overview, active workspace summary, account cards, and quick add action.

states.empty: No accounts or transactions yet. Add your first account to start tracking.
states.error: Database read error. Tap to reload local store.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with workspace switcher, hero balance summary card with subtle gradient, horizontal account selector, and recent immutable transactions feed.

screens.name: AccountLedger
screens.purpose: Append-only chronological transaction ledger with immutable audit trail and filtering.

states.error: Failed to load ledger. Retry connection.

screens.layout: Segmented filter bar at top, chronological grouped list by date, each row showing transaction note, category badge, and precise integer amount in paise (₹).

screens.name: AddExpense
screens.purpose: Validate amount in minor units and save transaction & ledger entries in one local DB transaction with outbox sync.
screens.layout: Sheet modal with numeric currency input (INR/paise integer validation), account picker, category selector, note field, and sticky bottom primary commit CTA.

screens.name: MonthlySpending
screens.purpose: Visual breakdown of monthly spending by category and budget progress.

states.empty: No spending records for this month.
states.error: Analytics calculation error. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Month selector header, summary progress cards against budget limits, and category breakdown bars.

screens.name: SyncOutbox
screens.purpose: Offline outbox status, pending sync queue, and conflict resolution monitor.

states.empty: All local changes fully synced to server.

screens.layout: Status banner at top, list of pending outbox queue items with entity type, operation, retry count, and manual 'Sync Now' trigger.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Secure settings, biometric lock toggle, backup, and workspace export.
screens.layout: Grouped iOS settings style list with icon containers in brandTertiary, biometric toggle, database export option, and app version info.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute workspaceId isolation on all SQLite queries. Implement append-only immutable ledger entries where corrections generate adjustment records. Store monetary amounts as integer minor units (paise). Maintain offline outbox queue for FastAPI sync with version/updatedAt conflict handling. Build with Expo React Native, TypeScript, Zustand, and SQLite.
